goal: Keep P1 moving by skipping blocked executor candidates while preserving qualification rigor and treatment definitions.
principles: do not spend effort repairing a provider-specific path before checking the next admissible candidate
do not weaken telemetry, identity, reproducibility, timeout, licensing, or cost-provenance requirements to force readiness
prefer zero/low-cost qualification paths when scientifically interchangeable
a newly discovered candidate may enter only through the same frozen screening contract
decision_loop: select next candidate from category priority
if blocked -> record blocker and skip
if surface-qualified -> run exactly the permitted S0 qualification probe
if S0-ready -> freeze binding for smoke matrix
if S0-not-ready -> record evidence and skip
continue until required category coverage exists or candidate universe is exhausted

category_priority.reason: minimize qualification and later treatment cost without changing the scientific role
strong path is required for B0 and escalation fallback
not required for the minimal P1 smoke

exhaustion_rule: If no admissible strong+economic pair can be qualified, do not infer that routing/escalation lacks value; record P1 as operationally blocked and continue only independent research work.
